description: Start a target by name. Returns the new session id to use with the other tools. Optional branch or checkout runs from a git worktree without moving the current folder.

branch.description: Git branch or remote ref to run from a Baton-owned copy. Mutually exclusive with checkout.

checkout.description: Path to an existing worktree to attach. Mutually exclusive with branch.

deviceId.description: Force a specific device or simulator.

target.description: Target name or an unambiguous substring of it.

name: run_target
